label: Road accident mortality (per registered motor vehicles)
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = ITF/IRTAD road-safety statistics via SDMX (OECD.ITF DSD_INDICATORS@DF_SAFETY), road fatalities per 10,000 registered motor vehicles as submitted by the member countries' police crash registration systems (FATALITIES/10P4VEH_MOT_ROAD, TRANSPORT_MODE=ROAD, all vehicle types, annual rows only — the same frame pins as the per-100k face, the unit the 1974 table's own denominator's descendant), 38 areas, 1994-2024 as the union window with HETEROGENEOUS per-area arrival (CHE 1994-2024 the longest series; FRA 2010-2024; most Western European windows 2013+; the per-vehicle registration counts arrived late — the coverage cliff carried as-printed, the honest shape this face's own notes document). No witness tier: no other machine door prints a per-vehicle road-death rate (the probe record — the top_income_share constitution, witnessless by necessity not by omission).

notes:
THE TODD ARC UNDER ITS OWN DENOMINATOR (todd_refs: the companion metric carries the 4 Le Fou et le Prolétaire citations — this face is the same book's own table shape): the 1974 WHO table Todd read printed deaths per MILLION vehicles; the IRTAD descendant prints per 10,000 (a pure unit shift on the same denominator concept — the ratio between the two faces of one registration universe). France 2010 = 0.95 -> 2024 = 0.65 per 10,000 vehicles (the threefold fall the per-100k face prints as 9.7 -> 4.7, the same crashes over a growing fleet — the denominator's own story: the fleet grew faster than the population, so the per-vehicle rate fell further).
THE HONEST LIMITS (each verified live on the full slice): the USA ABSENT (the IRTAD questionnaire never carried the US vehicle-registration series on this flow — the 1974 table's own third column has no modern machine face, the US rides the per-100k face only); RUS absent from the entire ITF flow (the v19 finding, unchanged); the heterogeneous arrival windows (per-area coverage printed as-is, never normalized); no sex dimension (the flow prints none — total road deaths); the 1974 table itself is BOOK data (thirteen countries, the WHO print Todd read — curated territory, the same line the 19th-century French boards hold).
THE COMPANION DISCIPLINE: the pair is declared on both sides (companion_indicators, the cross-validation's symmetry contract) — two indicators, one crash-registration root (itf_irtad), two denominators that are different measurements, never a conversion of one another. The boards read them side by side: the population face for the cross-metric mortality comparison (the family's own unit), the vehicle face for the machine-age intensity Todd's own table measured.
